blocks.x: Most enterprise bi & executive analytics engagements stall between the deck and the deployment. Ours are built to cross that gap: Metrics into management — one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.. What follows is the working pattern, not the brochure.

Executive analytics fails through metric anarchy: five definitions of revenue, three churn rates, dashboards nobody trusts. We implement a governed semantic layer — certified metric definitions, ownership, refresh SLAs — delivered through Power BI, Tableau or Looker, and then go further: aligning reporting to the operating cadence (daily huddles, weekly trading, monthly close) so numbers drive meetings rather than decorate them.

Self-service succeeds inside guardrails: certified datasets with promoted endorsement, sandbox zones for exploration, and a certification workflow that turns a popular sandbox report into a governed asset. We measure adoption by decision usage — who uses which metric in which meeting — because that, not dashboard count, is the point.

Programs of Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics run in Retail & Consumer Goods, Banking & Financial Services, Manufacturing & Industrial, Telecom, Media & Entertainment — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
